scope: Third selectable voxel version; improve storefront, paving and canopy without discarding the prior craft pass.
glass: Opaque cells with no central mullion. Recess panes approximately 0.28m from the facade, add continuous reveals and an outer sill. No painted interior or hidden non-voxel meshes.
site: Flat irregular polygon footprint with a shallow earth edge. Varied polygon flagstones form a front walkway, entry approach and terrace. Building foundations, furniture feet and planters remain supported at their existing heights.
canopy: Five crown areas linked by branching timber. Smaller leaf fans, intentional openings between boughs, reduced yellow contrast. Preserve a connected tree and a clear facade.
construction: Keep 20,000 steps and five phases. New objects use the existing phase and file contracts. Interior framing remains available during construction.
comparison: Initial, first craft pass and storefront/site pass selectable with separate in-memory edits. Same cell size, light and camera. Right-hand modular model remains the initial control.
